observations: Steal An Egg (94 days) still leads, ahead of Brookhaven, 99 Nights in the Forest, Murder Mystery 2, RIVALS and +1 Speed Keyboard Escape.
After yesterday's still day, movement returned: Dead Rails rose +44 and Survive Overnight in a Mega Store +30 with Halloween events, and What If Disasters (22 days) climbed +14.
Seven games entered, including It Hears The Water (13 days), Pave the Road (44 days), Demonology and Welcome to Bloxburg; BedWars Part 2, Kick a Lucky Block and Adopt Your Animal! fell off.
The age curve is U-shaped with the trough at 85–122 days (11th median percentile), against 80 for games 14 days or younger and 61 for games past a year, which may support H-mp-009 (40%).
patterns: Games left more than about 11 days without an update stay fewer days on the chart (r=-0.61 at the split); H-mp-018 at 65% tends to hold.
Pricier products (median above 472 R$, r=+0.46) and passes (median above 77 R$, r=+0.46) tend to go with longer presence, with age and visits as confounders.

Three of the five biggest risers are wave-survival games (Dead Rails, Survive Overnight in a Mega Store, What If Disasters) even though that loop sits at only the 34th median percentile, which suggests seasonal events lift it for a short time.
Solo loops consistently hold lower positions than social ones (H-mp-003 at 75%), and more original concepts consistently rank higher (H-mp-013 at 75%).

In the video set, social and PvP hits keep a light HUD (Brookhaven, RIVALS, Adopt Me!) while progression hits run a dense one (Blox Fruits, Emergency Hamburg), so HUD density follows the loop rather than success.

outliers.name: [👻EVENT] Dead Rails
outliers.note: At 664 days it made the biggest climb (+44) on the back of an event tag, a sign that a seasonal event can revive an older game.

outliers.name: Pave the Road
outliers.note: Entered Most Popular at 44 days with a 75% like ratio, against the job-sim weakness seen on Top Trending; its 'progress now saves' update may have reset retention.

observations: Donation hubs (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS) lead efficiency again, followed by Elemental Dungeons, Dinosaur Simulator and Project Baki.
Efficiency still rises with age: the 2nd median percentile at 0–14 days, 33 at 15–42, 41 at 43–84 and 60 past a year (H-te-001 at 81%).
Movement returned: 24 games entered, including REALISTIC HOME DEFENSE, Build and Burn, Tame An Animal, Steal A DNA and Project Baki, and 21 left.
Pet Simulator X rose +146, Create a Robot Fighter +110 and Pixel Basketball +102, while Run a Cheer Gym fell -84 and Tycoon, but one dropper -82.
patterns: A median developer product above 79 R$ consistently goes with higher efficiency (r=+0.41 at the split; H-te-005 at 83%).
RPGs (r=+0.44), roleplay loops (+0.30) and combat PvP consistently earn more per player, while Survival (-0.36), Simulation (-0.22) and steal-base loops (18th median percentile) earn less.
Complexity (+0.25), longer descriptions (+0.22), bigger servers (best split at 40 players, r=+0.41) and pricier passes consistently go with efficiency, with age as a shared confounder.
'Steal' titles (r=-0.44) and 'RP' titles (-0.38) carry the lowest efficiency among keywords, while roleplay loops in general rank high, so the RP title tag may mark smaller roleplay clones.

outliers.name: Pixel Lineage
outliers.note: Top Earning #95 at 32 days with a single game pass and 99% likes; it earns through currency and race spins, a counter case to the pass-count hypotheses.

outliers.name: Pet Simulator X! 🐾
outliers.note: Climbed +146 despite 48 days without an update, against the update hypotheses; Halloween spending in an old pet game is a likely reason.

outliers.name: 🎃 [HALLOWEEN] Hunting Together RPG
outliers.note: The listed counter case to H-te-011: an RPG that earns poorly for its players at 23 days, with Thai-language products pointing to a regional audience that spends less per player.

observations: roll the world (21 days) leads momentum at +34, followed by Throw Food For Animals +31, Realistic Ragdoll Engine +28, Cameraman Tower Defense +28 and SQUISHY DUMPLING PRISON RUN +23.
The youngest games carry the most momentum: 0–14 days at the 77th median percentile, 15–42 at 59 and 43–84 at 42.
Nineteen games entered, including My Small Business (10 days), My Bus, Scooter Duo, Spot and Mark! and older returners such as The Mimic and Pet Simulator 99.
Party and duel formats fell hardest: Keyboard Bridge Wars -33, Bridge Battles -32 and Make a Face -25, with Demonology -41.
patterns: Recently updated young games tend to climb faster (H-tt-005 rose to 65%), and more updates a week go with higher positions within age bands (+0.32), proposed today as a hypothesis.
Shorter titles tend to go with higher positions (H-tt-037 at 68%), and launching with more than 8 passes tends to go with lower ones (H-tt-032 at 68%).
A collection index tends to go with stronger young games (H-tt-028 at 69%), and a median product above about 85 R$ goes with higher positions within age bands (+0.39), proposed today.
Physics sandboxes (86), wave survival (77) and horror (66) lead by median percentile, while job sims (6) and party minigames (12) trail, each from small groups.

outliers.name: [🚀 SPACE] roll the world 🌎
outliers.note: Leads momentum despite a bracket tag, a luck pass and server-luck products, counter to H-tt-007 and H-tt-039; its Katamari-style growth loop and a fresh space update likely outweigh them.

outliers.name: Make Ramen To Get Rich [RELEASE]
outliers.note: Weakest on momentum at 19 days despite 22 passes, consistent with H-tt-032 on pass-heavy launches.

observations: DONT SPLASH (10 days) leads, ahead of My Small Business, Ragdoll Reality, Realistic Ragdoll Engine, A Long Flight and The Hollow.
Games 14 days or younger sit at the 94th median percentile against about 50 for older ones, the steepest age gap of the week (best split at 15 days, r=-0.60).
Steal A Pet And Ride It! rose +66, Tower Of Luck +63, Harvest It All +60, Climb The Locust Tower +51 and Flying Tesla Roadster +46.
Everyday-device games fell together: Apple iPad Original -43, Fix My Phone! -42 and Realistic Phone Drop Test -38, alongside +1 Animal Mog Evolution -44 and +1 Tackle Evolution -38.
Seventeen games entered, including FATHOM, Fake Dead or DIE, Durian Garden (6 days), Night Rider, Fart Raft!, Escape The Walls and Hide to Steal Eggs.
patterns: Gameplay thumbnails consistently go with higher positions (H-uc-040 at 73%; +0.31 within age), while reward-flex thumbnails rank lower (-0.19).
Recent updates consistently go with higher positions (H-uc-012 at 75%), and cash-tycoon loops consistently rank lower (H-uc-016 at 71%).
Asking players to like the game (+0.27 within age) and drivable vehicles (+0.23) may go with higher positions, proposed today as hypotheses.
Physics sandboxes (81) and wave survival (71) lead loops by median percentile while story adventures (11) and job sims (23) trail.

outliers.name: 🧸 My Small Business
outliers.note: A cash-tycoon build game at #2, the counter case for H-uc-016 and H-uc-029; its cute shop theme and 96% likes may carry it.

outliers.name: Climb The Locust Tower
outliers.note: Rose +51 while Steal Or Die also uses the same creator-made Locust monster, a hint that a popular indie character can carry several small games at once.

summary: Physics sandboxes and horror lead both breakout charts again: two ragdoll games sit in the top four of Up-and-Coming and among the best Top Trending climbers, and horror_escape is the largest loop on Up-and-Coming.

Games pull players first and monetize later: games 14 days or younger lead Up-and-Coming (94th percentile) and Top Trending (77th) while Top Earning efficiency climbs from the 2nd percentile at 0–14 days to the 60th past a year.
Updating often is the most consistent cross-chart signal: days since update goes against Most Popular, Top Trending and Up-and-Coming at once.
Halloween events lift older games across charts (Dead Rails, Survive Overnight in a Mega Store, The Mimic, Pet Simulator X), a seasonal confounder for update and age hypotheses this week.
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (111 entries, median 2 days), ahead of tt→mp (105, 2 days).
uc→te (76, 5 days), tt→te (72, 4 days), te→tt (70, 9 days) and uc→mp (65, 4 days) show breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.
